info.title: Relo integration API
info.description: Questions, work, cards and notifications for an app signed in with `relo auth login`; the session, harness-credential and owner routes the CLI uses; webhook services (`/hooks…`, a service secret in a header); and the device authorization flow any client signs in with. Every other route is private to the Dashboard and the iPhone app (INTERNAL_ROUTES in apps/server/src/openapi.ts). See docs/INTEGRATING.md.

bearer.description: A login token from `relo auth login` (or the device authorization routes).

webhookSecret.description: A service's secret, `hook_…`, in `Authorization: Bearer`. `X-Relo-Webhook-Secret: hook_…` also works. Never in the URL: a path with a secret is refused (`secret_in_url`).

post.description: A one-off alert. Never a question and never progress: use a Live Activity for those.

post.description: Approval, yes/no or a choice of 2-4 options; no typed answers. On a card (presentation=live_activity) the prompt is one line of at most 120 characters and the explanation goes in `detail` (markdown, up to 4,000). expiresInSeconds is capped by the server admin (7 days by default). With `callback`, Relo POSTs the answer signed with Relo-Signature: t=UNIX,v1=HMAC-SHA256(token, "UNIX.BODY") and a stable Relo-Delivery-Id.

post.description: An agent session's own surface: one open work per session. Starting again continues the open work; `new` parks it; `from` (a handoff handle) takes over the work another session of this computer handed off (`handoff_invalid`, `handoff_finished`). Text is `{ readable }` or `{ sealed: true }` with the sealed envelope. Scopes: activities:write.

occurredAt.description: When the change originally happened, if it is sent later than the event. Requires ifSequence.

status.description: One line saying what is happening now.

detail.description: Longer text shown under the status. Null clears it.

progress.description: How far along the work is, as a fraction of the whole. Null clears it.

progressLabel.description: Short text shown beside the progress, such as a count. Null clears it.

steps.description: A short row of labelled steps with the current one marked.

labels.description: Labels of the steps shown on the card, in order.

current.description: Which of the given labels is in progress, counting from the first.

before.description: How many earlier steps of a longer plan are hidden before these labels; they count as done.

after.description: How many later steps of a longer plan are hidden after these labels; they count as not started.

plan.description: Where the work stands in its plan: steps done of total, the current step, its substeps, and the round (plan UX U1, U2).

accentColor.description: Accent color of the card as a six-digit hex value such as #1A73E8.

style.description: Layout of the card on the Lock Screen.

staleAfterSeconds.description: How long without an update before the card is shown as stale.

deliveryPriority.description: Delivery priority for the push; the only accepted value asks for immediate delivery.

context.description: Where the work runs and what it belongs to, shown with the card.

providerName.description: Name of the tool or product doing the work, shown as the source.

producerKind.description: What kind of sender this is: an agent, a service, a webhook or a manual action.

computer.description: Name of the machine the work runs on.

account.description: Name of the account the work runs under.

project.description: Name of the project the work belongs to.

providerThreadId.description: The sender's own id for the conversation or thread, used to group items from one thread.

providerWorkItemId.description: The sender's own id for the task or work item.

threadNameSource.description: Where threadName came from: the provider, set explicitly, or a fallback.

taskTitleSource.description: Where taskTitle came from: the provider, a summary of the prompt, set explicitly, or a fallback.

lifecycle.description: Identity of the agent session that owns the card, used to find, update and end it.

ifSequence.description: Apply the change only if the card is at exactly this sequence; otherwise it is refused, so a stale writer cannot overwrite a newer change.

presentation.description: A complete presentation record to show instead of the separate title, status and similar fields; the two cannot be combined.

sealed.description: End-to-end sealed card text; the readable fields then carry placeholders.

401.description: The credential was refused; `error` says why

parameters.description: Repeat a request with the same key to get the first result instead of a second effect.

sealed.description: True when the text travels in the sealed field instead.

goal.description: What the work is for, in the owner's words: the card's title.

status.description: What is happening now, in real words.

sealed.description: True when the text travels in the sealed field instead.

plan.description: The steps, as a plan command (usually set with the step labels).

op.description: Replaces the steps still to do in the open round with this list; done steps stay and unlisted ones are skipped.

steps.description: The steps still to do, in order; entries may nest.

op.description: Appends steps to the end of the open round, as the last children of one step, or as siblings right after one step.

steps.description: The steps to append, in order; entries may nest.

under.description: Id of the step the new steps go under; leave out to append at the end of the round.

after.description: Id of the step the new steps follow, as its siblings; not together with under.

op.description: Marks the current step done and moves to the next open one.
Makes one step (a step without sub-steps) the current one; the previous current step counts as done.

id.description: Id of the step to make current.

op.description: Lists the steps still to do by label; labels that match an existing step keep it.

labels.description: The labels of the steps still to do, in order.

op.description: Opens the next round of the work; the last round must be closed.

title.description: What the round is for, in a few words.

steps.description: The round's steps, in order; entries may nest. Without steps the round carries the unfinished steps of the one before.

op.description: Closes the open round: the current step counts as done; open steps are refused unless dropRest skips them.

outcome.description: What the round delivered, in a line.

dropRest.description: Close the round although steps are still open: they are skipped.

op.description: Sets the detail text of a step; an empty text clears it.

id.description: Id of the step; leave out for the current step.

detail.description: The detail text.

progress.description: A count for work without a plan, or for the current step (done of total).

total.description: How many units there are in all.

leaseSeconds.description: How long the work may stay silent and still count as moving; renew it with a heartbeat.

producerKey.description: Services only: names this job, so later calls find the same work.

new.description: Start a new work even if one is open (the open one is parked); otherwise a repeat start continues it.

context.description: Where the work runs (project, computer, account), as the CLI declares it; sealed fields arrive as handles.

sealed.description: The card text sealed to the owner's phones (an end-to-end envelope the CLI builds); with it, text fields are sent as { sealed: true }.

producerSealed.description: A copy of the work's text sealed to the producer itself, so it can restore its own work later.

id.description: Id of an existing step to keep; leave out for a new step.

label.description: What the step is, in a few words.

detail.description: One or two sentences of detail for the step.

children.description: Sub-steps, in order; use only when a step cannot be finished in one go.
